title: Radiant Crown

outfit_card.silhouette: Regal floor-length column gown paired with sweeping sheer cape-sleeves, structured solar cuirass bodice, flowing into an elongated A-line flared train silhouette.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Towering filigree gold crown featuring multi-tiered starburst finials, encrusted pearls, delicate draped chain swags, and a central forehead-suspended radiant star emblem.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: High-neck ivory silk bodice overlaid with an ornate sculpted golden sunburst breastplate, structured metallic epaulets releasing floor-length flowing translucent cape streamers, and segmented golden forearm bracers.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Voluminous floor-grazing golden lamé skirt paneled with ivory satin, detailed with intricate radiant sun motifs and filigree star hemline embroidery cascading into a fluid, majestic royal train.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Radiant solar halo iconography, eight-pointed celestial stars, luminous auric light accents, and intricate fluted architectural gold relief patterns.
